name: Germany
summary: Central European industrial economy pursuing Energiewende transition. Reached majority renewable electricity generation in 2023 while accelerating industrial heat electrification and phasing out domestic lignite coal.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 2.04x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); meets current European Union ambient limit of 25 µg/m³.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; tied with 2022 as warmest year in DWD nationwide observational history.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate of +0.46 °C per decade across central European continental stations.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.6% share of global fossil emissions; lowest national annual emissions total since the 1950s.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Above EU average due to historic industrial baseload reliance on domestic lignite and hard coal.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Extensive mixed beech and spruce forest reserves ~114,000 km² under close sustainable forestry management.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Historic milestone: wind (31.1%), solar PV (12.1%), and biomass (6.2%) exceeded 50% of annual generation.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 242 people/km²; urban population fraction is 77.7%.
